## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete change and its user impact.

## Validation

List relevant checks and their results. Distinguish local tests, native harness verification, and live API calls.

## Release impact

Note changes to instruction behavior, schemas, package interfaces, installation, or compatibility.

- [ ] Every significant addition, fix, removal, or behavior change has an entry in `CHANGELOG.md` under `Unreleased`, or the release being prepared, following `docs/changelog.md`.
- [ ] Entries explain affected components and impact, with migration actions and material verification limits when relevant.

If no entry is needed, briefly explain why the change has no significant consumer or maintainer impact.
